scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && vite build
scripts.start: concurrently --names "dev,ws,queue,schedule" --prefix-colors "green,cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev" "php artisan reverb:start" "php artisan queue:work" "php artisan schedule:work"
scripts.types: php artisan scramble:clear && php artisan scramble:export --path=frontend/src/api/api.json && node frontend/scripts/patch-schema.js && npm run types -w frontend
scripts.pull: git stash && git pull && git stash apply
